ai.seo_question: What were the two main actions of Pharaoh in rejecting Prophet Moses?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse encapsulates the dual failure of Pharaoh: intellectual denial (kaththaba) and volitional rebellion (asā), reflecting his refusal to submit even when confronted with clear miracles. This combination underscores the archetype of the tyrant who possesses knowledge but rejects it out of pride, a theme central to the narrative of Musa and Fir'awn in Surah Al-Zariyat.
